signup_type.description: The entry type your sign-ups use (subscribers, members, RSVPs). Each published one counts.

audience_name.description: What to call your sign-ups, in the plural. The card reads, for example, "100 subscribers".

draft_entry_type.description: The entry type the thank-you post is drafted as.

draft_body_field.description: The text field on that entry type where the post goes.

footer.description: A line at the bottom of the card, such as your website address.
